## 2026-10-06 — WEEKLY-2026-10-06

Tuesday WEEKLY (2026-09-29→2026-10-06): one new T1 LegCo briefing transcript — on **2026-10-06** the Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development (SCED) briefed the LegCo Panel on Information Technology and Broadcasting on the First Five-Year Plan and 2026 Policy Address. The Chinese-only GIA restates that the Communications Authority **launched the UAS dedicated-spectrum licensing regime in October 2025**, that it is **aligned with Mainland spectrum planning**, and that it will help **future cross-boundary drone operations**; the government will also encourage cross-border 6G technical trials and scenario validation including low-altitude economy. This is a **restatement**, not a new OFCA spectrum instrument; the 1430–1444 MHz licence remains Sandbox-confined. Mainland comparator: Xinhua (**2026-09-30**) reports the Ministry of Public Security disclosed a UAS administrative-penalty discretion benchmark (《公安机关依法处置涉无人驾驶航空器违法行为行政处罚裁量基准》), effective on issuance; the MPS primary text was **not** read. **Late catch (outside window):** CAD lists Gazette **G.N. 5936** (Director-General of Civil Aviation, dated 2026-09-21, effective **2026-09-26**) designating restricted flying zones to facilitate LAE Regulatory Sandbox pilot projects. **Action Plan full published text remains OPEN**; Sandbox X cross-boundary results remain OPEN; CAAC ATM Rules still draft. No new CAD AC, Cap.448G amending instrument, NBS/NDRC scale under 1676号, or evidenced SZ–HK UAS corridor operations.

**Still not fact:** operational Shenzhen–HK UAS corridor; NBS national LAE 规模 under 1676号; published Action Plan full text; Sandbox X cross-boundary selection results.

## 2026-10-04 — WEEKLY-2026-10-04

Sunday WEEKLY (2026-09-27→2026-10-04): one new T1 LegCo briefing transcript — on **2026-10-02** the Secretary for Transport and Logistics (STL) briefed the LegCo Panel on Economic Development on the First Five-Year Plan and 2026 Policy Address. The Chinese-only GIA restates PA LAE commitments: **>140** Sandbox projects regularised; Working Group **continues to formulate** 《發展低空經濟規劃行動綱領》 this year; commit to **complete drafting** dedicated unconventional-aircraft legislation **next year** and submit to LegCo; Smart Low-altitude Traffic Management System progressive from **2028**. This is **policy restatement / LegCo briefing only**, not a new legal instrument, Sandbox X results list, or market figure. **Action Plan full published text remains OPEN** (PA ¶139 / highlight still “will formulate” / “Formulate”; STL still “繼續全力制訂”). No new CAD AC, Cap.448G amending instrument, OFCA spectrum change, TLB Sandbox X cross-boundary results list, CAAC ATM final rule, NBS/NDRC scale under 1676号, or evidenced SZ–HK UAS corridor operations.

**Still not fact:** operational Shenzhen–HK UAS corridor; NBS national LAE 规模 under 1676号; published Action Plan full text; Sandbox X cross-boundary selection results.

## 2026-09-20 — WEEKLY-2026-09-20

Sunday WEEKLY (2026-09-13→2026-09-20): major T1 cluster on **2026-09-16** — Chief Executive’s **2026 Policy Address** (GIA part 4; policyaddress.gov.hk Ch.III ¶137–139) and the **First Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development of the HKSAR (2026–2030)**. PA commits to formulate the **Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy** (中文：「發展低空經濟規劃行動綱領」) with three named actions (cross-boundary logistics trial flights ASAP; Smart Low-altitude Traffic Management System progressive from **2028**; begin drafting legislation for unconventional aircraft **>150 kg**). PA Annex indicators lock TLB timelines: indicator **34** (Smart TMS from 2028) and **35** (complete drafting of >150 kg legislation **within 2027**). Five-Year Plan GIA restates Asia-Pacific hub for innovative low-altitude applications. **Action Plan full published text remains OPEN** (PA says “will formulate”; not a gazette statute). No new CAD AC, Cap.448G amending instrument, OFCA spectrum change, TLB Sandbox X cross-boundary results list, or CAAC final ATM / background-review rule. CAAC ATM Rules (征求意见稿) page still draft after 2026-09-11 comment close.

**Still not fact:** operational Shenzhen–HK UAS corridor; NBS national LAE 规模 under 1676号; published Action Plan full text; Sandbox X cross-boundary selection results; full HK–Kazakhstan MoU PDF beyond speech attestation.

## 2026-09-05 — Baseline

Baseline dossier for the DOTE5891 companion site, built from **primary and official sources**.

### What we treat as settled

1. **Definitions / scale.** HK LAE working definition = economic activities generally **below 1,000 m** (LegCo CB(3)933/2024, T2). Mainland statistical definition = NDRC **发改低空〔2025〕1676号** (2025-12-22, T2). HK has **no** official LAE value-added series yet.
2. **HK map.** Working Group (DFS head; first meeting **12 Nov 2024**); CAD / **Cap. 448G**; **Regulatory Sandbox** ≠ **Regulatory Sandbox X** (AC-013 vs AC-017); **1430–1444 MHz** UAS (Private) Licence from **27 Oct 2025**.
3. **National spine.** Civil Aviation Law revision — passed **2025-12-27**, Order No. 65, effective **2026-07-01** (T1). UAS ops still **国令761 + CCAR-92** (both eff. **2024-01-01**).
4. **GBA evidenced.** Guangdong 粤府办〔2024〕6号; Shenzhen **domestic** blood UAS (Jan 2024). **Not** evidenced: operational Shenzhen–HK medical drone corridor.
5. **AUDIT HK$350bn.** Issuer = **Our Hong Kong Foundation**, *Taking Flight…*, **Sep 2025**. Metric = **industry value-added**, **Hong Kong only**, horizon **2050**. **Not** a government figure.

### Allowed 350bn wording

> OHKF (Sep 2025) projects ~HK$350 billion **industry value-added** in Hong Kong by 2050 (majority from supporting services).

## What this note added

- Sandbox vs Sandbox X **resolved** as two official programmes (AC-013 / AC-017).
- HK$350bn **issuer locked** (OHKF T3); misattribution to HKSAR gov blocked.
- Civil Aviation Law **1 Jul 2026** effective date **confirmed** (T1).
- Cross-border medical corridor demoted from “open” pedagogy claim to **planned/trial**.

## Terms that must not be mixed

“LAE / 低空经济” = industrial-policy / statistical construct. UAM / AAM / IAM / UAS / SUA = aviation system / vehicle terms — do not equate. HK **1,000 m** working definition ≠ Mainland airspace **120 m / 300 m** class labels.
